usedFor: CalendarHero holds the meeting requests, and HubSpot records the outcome with “Update Contact” after “Meeting Request Becomes Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “Meeting Request Becomes Event” in CalendarHero, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A request that becomes an event is a booked meeting, so the contact can be updated at that point.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so the meeting request must carry the email HubSpot already holds.
